# HP Support Community

> > A comprehensive peer-to-peer support community for HP devices including notebooks, printers, and AI-powered computers with forums, knowledge bases, and expert guidance.

HP Support Community is a user-driven support platform where customers can find troubleshooting help, product discussions, and community-contributed solutions for HP hardware and software. The community covers notebooks, printers, mobile printing, and emerging AI PC products with dedicated forums for specific device categories and technical issues.

## Key Topics

- HP Notebooks
- HP Printers
- Windows 11 Support
- LaserJet
- AI PCs
- Driver Issues
- Hardware Troubleshooting
- Wireless & Networking
- Operating System Recovery
- HP Smart App
- Mobile Printing
- EliteBook
- Poly Devices
- Community Forum
- Knowledge Base

## Getting Started

- [Home - HP Support Community](https://h30434.www3.hp.com): HP Support Community homepage for notebooks, printers, desktops, and devices
- [Welcome to the Community - HP Support Community](https://h30434.www3.hp.com/t5/Welcome-to-the-Community/ct-p/about): Community welcome page with guidelines and orientation for HP Support users
- [First Time Here? Learn How to Post and More - HP Support Community](https://h30434.www3.hp.com/t5/First-Time-Here-Learn-How-to-Post-and-More/bd-p/Hello): Getting started guide for new community members on posting and features

## Notebook Support

- [Notebooks - HP Support Community](https://h30434.www3.hp.com/t5/Notebooks/ct-p/Notebook): HP Notebooks support forum for hardware, software, and troubleshooting
- [Notebook Operating System and Recovery - HP Support Community](https://h30434.www3.hp.com/t5/Notebook-Operating-System-and-Recovery/bd-p/OS): Support forum for Windows recovery and operating system troubleshooting
- [Notebook Hardware and Upgrade Questions - HP Support Community](https://h30434.www3.hp.com/t5/Notebook-Hardware-and-Upgrade-Questions/bd-p/Hardware): Support forum for HP notebook hardware upgrades and compatibility
- [Notebook Wireless and Networking - HP Support Community](https://h30434.www3.hp.com/t5/Notebook-Wireless-and-Networking/bd-p/Internet): Support forum for HP notebook WiFi, networking, and connectivity issues
- [Notebook Video, Display and Touch - HP Support Community](https://h30434.www3.hp.com/t5/Notebook-Video-Display-and-Touch/bd-p/Display): Support forum for HP notebook display, touch screen, and video issues
- [Notebook Boot and Lockup - HP Support Community](https://h30434.www3.hp.com/t5/Notebook-Boot-and-Lockup/bd-p/Laptop-Freeze): Support forum for HP notebook boot, freezing, and crash troubleshooting
- [Notebook Software and How To Questions - HP Support Community](https://h30434.www3.hp.com/t5/Notebook-Software-and-How-To-Questions/bd-p/Recovery): Support forum for HP notebook software and application troubleshooting
- [Notebook Audio - HP Support Community](https://h30434.www3.hp.com/t5/Notebook-Audio/bd-p/Sound): Support forum for HP notebook audio, speakers, and microphone issues
- [Business Notebooks - HP Support Community](https://h30434.www3.hp.com/t5/Business-Notebooks/bd-p/General): Support forum for HP EliteBook and business notebook products
- [AI PCs - HP Support Community](https://h30434.www3.hp.com/t5/AI-PCs/bd-p/ai-notebooks): Support forum for HP AI PCs including Spectre and OmniBook models
- [Notebooks Knowledge Base - HP Support Community](https://h30434.www3.hp.com/t5/Notebooks-Knowledge-Base/tkb-p/notebooks-knowledge-base): Knowledge base for HP notebook troubleshooting and FAQs

## Printer Support

- [Printers - HP Support Community](https://h30434.www3.hp.com/t5/Printers/ct-p/InkJet): HP printer support forum for hardware issues and troubleshooting
- [LaserJet Printing - HP Support Community](https://h30434.www3.hp.com/t5/LaserJet-Printing/bd-p/Install): Support forum for HP LaserJet printer issues and driver installation
- [Mobile Printing & Cloud Printing - HP Support Community](https://h30434.www3.hp.com/t5/Mobile-Printing-Cloud-Printing/bd-p/Photo): Support forum for HP Smart App, mobile printing, and cloud connectivity

## Community & Resources

- [Community Blog - HP Support Community](https://h30434.www3.hp.com/t5/Community-Blog/bg-p/Bestof): HP community blog with product updates, Windows 11, and AI features
- [Poly Blog - HP Support Community](https://h30434.www3.hp.com/t5/Poly-Blog/bg-p/Poly): Poly blog covering meeting devices, headsets, and hybrid work solutions
- [Volunteer Lounge - HP Support Community](https://h30434.www3.hp.com/t5/Volunteer-Lounge/bd-p/volunteer-lounge): Community space for volunteer moderators and support contributors
